contextScope: The original Riesz carrier preserves squarefree support, Möbius signs, logarithmic phases and complex fibre correlations. direction.statement: Seek a contradiction at any hypothetical right-half zeta zero by proving an independent estimate incompatible with the original Riesz carrier’s forced source limit. Preserve Möbius signs, logarithmic phases and full frequency correlations through conditioned-energy estimates. Stronger zero-free regions narrow the remaining strip; the arithmetic saving is still open.
direction.changeReason: Establish the dedicated RH campaign view, distinguishing the long-term signed-carrier strategy from its zero-free-region and numerical-certificate work.

latestUpdate.title: Literal damped zeta blocks inherit the saving; Gaussian costs are uniform.
latestUpdate.body: For each fixed k≥12, the proved rectangle saving now reaches every nonnegative decreasing weight family and the actual damped zeta coefficients. The main term pays total weight and the endpoint error only the initial weight. All Gaussian constants together cost at most 2 after the actual moment root. Moment constants and starting thresholds remain unevaluated; the zero-free region is unchanged.

scopes.boundScope: Furthest checked carrier bound: at a=0,b=1, use the proved critical homogeneous exponent 2k(u+1)-k(k+1)/2+eps for every eps>0, with k>=2,u>=k. The complete initial allowance is at most B*p^beta, -1/2<=beta<0, with every homogeneous and descendant-energy premise discharged. Prime, padded-quotient and p^S<=X conditions are explicit. Constants and thresholds are unevaluated. Full signed correlations, sampling and block normalization remain; their combined saving is unproved. RH remains open.
scopes.sourceScope: Under the displayed hypothetical right-half-zero assumptions, the normalized original carrier has the prescribed negative-multiplicity source limit. This conditional source identity supplies one side of the proposed contradiction; its independent arithmetic counterpart remains open.
scopes.initialConditioningScope: The unweighted critical moment exponent plus every eps>0 holds for k>=2,u>=k at sufficiently large endpoints. For each k>=12 the full eligible degree window gives the actual imaginary-power product sum a saving 1/(128*k^2) throughout M^(2k-2)<=t<=M^(2k), M^4<=z<=4*M^4. Original Dirichlet blocks of length M^4 starting at M^4<=z<=2*M^4 have bound C*M^(4-1/(128*k^2)); every partial block has its explicit endpoint allowance. Both moments, all Gaussian tails, smoothing, Taylor errors and averaging masses are paid. Constants and thresholds are unevaluated for each fixed degree. Uniform degree costs, all-scale zeta growth and the combined Riesz weighted saving remain open. Finite Abel transport also preserves every nonnegative decreasing weight family, including literal zeta coefficients at nonnegative real part. The main term pays actual total weight and the endpoint only its initial weight. All Gaussian constants cost at most two after the actual moment root, uniformly for k>=12; moment constants and thresholds remain unevaluated.
scopes.exponentAuditScope: Exact normalization audit: after restoring the source scale, lowering the exponent changes only the deep remainder by the coarse-quotient power. Every original intermediate conditioned energy is identical. The complete scaled allowance is no larger when a full coarse window fits. This comparison bounds no intermediate energy and does not prove RH.
scopes.fullRecurrenceScope: The general original-carrier recurrence applies to every displayed finite scale pair a<=b and depth H. Both actual quotient moments use the proved first improved exponent; all intermediate energies remain in the full allowance. The default view uses the critical exponent plus positive epsilon and a proved negative initial profile under its deeper cutoff conditions. No net signed correlation saving or RH contradiction is asserted.
